Hi Alice / team 

Quick technical answers and an implementation sketch to help Bob plan the staging work: 

Streaming behavior- Redwood supports token-level streaming (chunked HTTP streaming over our SDK or via server-sent events / websockets). You can receive partial responses as they generate and show them live in the agent UI. Early function invocation: you can implement a confidence threshold on the client or via a lightweight policy in the agent; we also support model-side tool-calling (function calling) where the model decides when to invoke a tool and returns a structured payload.

Tool-calling / structured results- We expose a function-calling interface (JSON schema you register) and the model will return: {"name": "fetch_kb", "arguments": { ... }} when it decides to call. Our SDK maps that into an event with a typed payload so your UI can render the result and optionally call the tool endpoint. We'll attach a short example in the integration checklist.

API & SDK quick-start (high-level)- SDK (Node / Python) install, auth via API key or short-lived token (we'll provision a staging key):

Node example:
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });

// streaming generate
const stream = client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-rt-medium', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt }], stream: true });
stream.on('token', t => sendToUI(t));
stream.on('done', info => console.log('done', info));

// function calling config (register schema server-side)
client.functions.register('fetch_kb', { query: 'string', top_k: 'integer' });

// on model return: handle structured result and call your KB service

Endpoints you will use:
- POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat (sync)
- POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream (streaming)
- POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/functions/execute (optional managed function-exec)

Authentication & environment- For the POC we'll provide a staging API key and a dedicated model variant pinned to us-west. If you need VPC routing for data residency, we can discuss Redwood Private but that's not required for the initial dev loop.

Performance testing- We'll run a simple load script from our side (10\u201320 rps) to validate latency targets once streaming and tool-calling are wired. For KV/prefix cache: recommend caching top-K responses on your side (we can provide best-practice config).

Attachments: short SDK snippets and an API route mapping in the integration checklist.

Let me know when Bob shares the staging host and I'll coordinate API key provisioning and a short handoff call with your engs.
